stylised curled/braided hair rendered as rows of ringlets

justification: Both are single large heads in right-facing profile filling a rectangular relief panel, with a decorated headband/crown, an almond profile eye, and hair or plumage rendered as dense repeated rows of curls or scale-like units — a fairly specific shared scheme of the monumental profile head bust. The decisive difference is the subject: A is a raptor-headed beast with a hooked beak, mane and clawed forelimb, while B is a bearded human wearing a tall cap with a second figure behind, with no animal features..
